battery.name: Vehicle Battery

symptoms: Rapid clicking sound or silence when pressing start button / turning key
Headlights dim noticeably when cranking engine
Battery warning light illuminated on dashboard instrument cluster
Voltage drops below 10V during starter crank
checks: Check resting terminal voltage with multimeter (healthy is >= 12.6V)
Inspect terminal posts for blue/white powdery sulfation corrosion
Verify alternator/stator charging rate (13.8V to 14.4V at 2,500 RPM)

battery.safety_guidance: Always disconnect negative (-) terminal first and reconnect it last to avoid catastrophic short circuits. Battery acid is highly corrosive—wear eye protection.

spark_plug.name: Spark Plug

symptoms: Engine misfires under hard acceleration
Difficulty starting cold engine
Uneven, rough engine idling and rpm fluctuation
Sudden drop in fuel economy and throttle response
checks: Inspect ceramic insulator and electrode color (tan/grey is healthy; black is rich/soot)
Measure electrode gap clearance with a feeler gauge
Check for oil fouling from leaky valve stem seals or worn piston rings

spark_plug.safety_guidance: Wait until the engine cylinder head is completely cold before unscrewing spark plugs to prevent stripping sensitive aluminum cylinder head threads.

brake_rotor.name: Brake Rotor (Disc)

specifications.Material: Cast Grey Iron / Stainless Steel / Carbon Ceramic
specifications.Design: Solid (Rear / Light Bikes) / Ventilated / Drilled & Slotted
specifications.Minimum Thickness Stamp: Typically stamped on rotor hub (e.g. Min Th 4.0mm)

price_estimate.note: Bike discs: ₹750 - ₹2,200; Car front ventilated rotors (pair): ₹2,500 - ₹5,000

symptoms: Pulsation or vibration felt in brake pedal or handlebar brake lever
Deep visible circular grooves or scoring lines on rotor face
Blue or purple thermal discoloration from extreme heat
Grinding metallic noise during deceleration
checks: Measure disc thickness with a digital micrometer against manufacturer minimum stamp
Use a dial gauge indicator to measure lateral runout (should be < 0.05 mm)
Inspect for hairline thermal stress cracks radiating from ventilation holes

brake_rotor.safety_guidance: Never spray lubricants, WD-40, or grease anywhere near brake rotors. Only use dedicated residue-free brake cleaner spray.

brake_pad.name: Brake Pads

specifications.Backplate: Steel stamped with acoustic wear indicator clip

price_estimate.note: Bike front pads: ₹250 - ₹900; Car axle set: ₹1,200 - ₹3,500

symptoms: High-pitched squealing noise when lightly applying brakes
Harsh metal-on-metal scraping sound (friction material completely worn down)
Extended braking distance and spongy brake lever travel
Brake dust accumulating excessively on alloy wheels
checks: Inspect pad friction lining thickness through caliper inspection window
Check for uneven taper wear indicating stuck caliper slider pins
Check for glazed, mirror-like friction surfaces due to excessive riding the brake

brake_pad.safety_guidance: Replace brake pads immediately if lining is below 2mm. After fitting new pads, pump the brake lever/pedal several times to seat them before riding/driving.

brake_caliper.name: Brake Caliper Assembly

specifications.Type: Floating Single/Twin Piston or Fixed 4/6 Piston
specifications.Fluid Compatibility: DOT 3, DOT 4, or DOT 5.1 Glycol Ether
specifications.Seals: High-temperature EPDM rubber square piston seal & dust boot

price_estimate.note: Bike single caliper: ₹1,100 - ₹2,500; Car replacement caliper: ₹2,800 - ₹7,000

symptoms: Vehicle pulls to one side during braking
Brake dragging—wheel feels hot and does not spin freely when lifted
Brake fluid weeping around caliper piston dust seals or bleed nipple
Spongy pedal travel caused by air trapped in caliper chambers
checks: Inspect slide pins for free sliding movement and grease with high-temp silicone
Examine piston face for corrosion or pitting under the dust boot
Perform complete brake fluid flush and bleed to clear trapped air bubbles

brake_caliper.safety_guidance: Brake fluid damages automotive paintwork rapidly. Wipe spills instantly with soapy water. Never mix mineral oil with DOT glycol brake fluid.

radiator.name: Engine Radiator

specifications.Core Construction: Aluminum multi-tube and louvered fin design
specifications.Operating Pressure: 0.9 bar - 1.3 bar (13 - 18 PSI regulated by radiator cap)
specifications.Coolant Type: 50/50 mix of Ethylene Glycol / Distilled Water (OAT / HOAT)

symptoms: Engine temperature gauge needle rising into red zone / high temp alert
Puddle of sweet-smelling green, pink, or orange coolant beneath the vehicle
Steam or sweet white mist rising from engine bay / front grill
Internal sludge preventing coolant circulation
checks: Inspect radiator core for bent fins, bug accumulation, or road debris
Check radiator plastic tank seams and hose clamped joints for crusty leaks
Verify radiator cap spring pressure seal and overflow tank coolant level

radiator.safety_guidance: NEVER open a radiator cap or expansion tank while the engine is hot. Pressurized scalding boiling coolant can erupt and cause severe third-degree burns.

headlights.name: Headlight Assembly

specifications.Bulb Technologies: Halogen (H4, H7) / HID Xenon / Modern Multi-Projector LED

symptoms: One or both low/high beams failing to illuminate
Yellow, cloudy, or hazy outer lens diffusing light beam
Internal moisture droplets and condensation after rain or washing
Flickering lights indicating loose relay, ground connection, or stator issue
checks: Inspect bulb filament or LED ballast connector for corrosion
Check headlight beam alignment against a flat vertical wall at 25 feet
Check housing rear rubber dust boots for tears letting in moisture

headlights.safety_guidance: Never touch the glass portion of a halogen bulb with bare fingers; skin oils create localized hot spots that cause the quartz glass to shatter prematurely.

rim.name: Wheel Rim

specifications.Material: Cast / Forged Aluminum Alloy or Steel Spoke

price_estimate.note: Bike alloy rim: ₹2,200 - ₹4,800; Car alloy wheel single: ₹3,500 - ₹12,000

symptoms: Steering wheel or handlebar vibrations at speeds above 60 km/h
Slow tubeless tire pressure drop over 2-3 days without puncture
Visible dent, flat spot, or crack on rim outer flange after pothole impact
Uneven tire tread cupping
checks: Place wheel on a balancing rig to measure dynamic runout and imbalance
Apply soapy water around rim bead seating edge to spot microscopic air leaks
Inspect inner rim barrel for hairline stress cracks

rim.safety_guidance: Never weld or heat-repair cracked structural cast alloy wheels; metallurgical weakening can lead to catastrophic wheel collapse at highway speeds.

oil_filter.name: Engine Oil Filter

specifications.Filtration Media: Pleated synthetic micro-glass or resin-impregnated cellulose
specifications.Internal Valve: Anti-drainback silicone valve + pressure bypass relief valve

price_estimate.note: Bike oil filter: ₹90 - ₹350; Car spin-on filter: ₹250 - ₹850

symptoms: Low engine oil pressure warning indicator staying on after startup
Dark, gritty engine oil circulating prematurely
Oil seepage around the filter sealing ring gasket
Engine ticking / valvetrain clatter due to restricted oil flow
checks: Always replace oil filter with every scheduled engine oil drain
Check old filter base to ensure old rubber O-ring came off with it (avoid double gasket)
Inspect cut-open filter pleats for glittering metallic shavings

oil_filter.safety_guidance: Always lubricate the new filter rubber O-ring with a film of fresh motor oil before installing. Hand-tighten firmly plus 3/4 turn—never overtorque with a wrench.

starter.name: Starter Motor

specifications.Motor Type: Permanent Magnet DC Motor with Gear Reduction
specifications.Engagement: Electromagnetic solenoid shifting Bendix drive gear into flywheel

price_estimate.note: Bike starter motor: ₹1,200 - ₹2,800; Car starter motor: ₹3,200 - ₹7,500

symptoms: Single loud 'click' sound from relay without the engine turning over
Whirring electric spin noise without engine cranking (bendix not engaging)
Slow, sluggish crank even when battery voltage is verified healthy
Burning electrical smell near starter after prolonged starting attempts
checks: Measure voltage at starter heavy 12V terminal while key is in crank position
Inspect starter relay contacts and engine grounding strap for voltage drop
Inspect carbon brush wear and armature commutator bars for burn marks

starter.safety_guidance: Never hold the starter button down for more than 5 to 7 seconds continuously. Allow 30 seconds between cranking attempts to prevent stator winding burnout.

piston.name: Engine Piston & Rings

specifications.Material: Cast or Forged Hypereutectic Aluminum Alloy
specifications.Ring Pack: Top compression ring, second scraper ring, three-piece oil control ring

price_estimate.note: Bike piston kit: ₹900 - ₹2,500; Car piston set: ₹3,500 - ₹9,500 (excl. labor)

symptoms: Blue-grey exhaust smoke under acceleration (oil burning past rings)
Excessive blow-by gases puffing from oil filler cap / crankcase breather
Severe loss of engine power, hill-climbing torque, and compression
Loud metallic piston slap noise from cylinder when engine is cold
checks: Perform a dry and wet cylinder compression test (healthy is 130 - 180 PSI)
Perform a cylinder leak-down test to verify ring vs valve seal leakage
Inspect cylinder bore walls for vertical scoring marks and wear ridge

piston.safety_guidance: Engine internal tear-down requires precision mechanical tools and specific torque sequences. Always use engine assembly lube when fitting new rings.

cylinder_head.name: Cylinder Head & Valves

specifications.Valvetrain: SOHC / DOHC with 2, 4, or 5 valves per cylinder
specifications.Material: Heat-treated Aluminum Alloy with hardened valve seat inserts

price_estimate.note: Head gasket replacement: ₹1,500 - ₹6,000; Complete cylinder head: ₹5,000 - ₹25,000

symptoms: Milky frothy brown sludge on engine oil cap or dipstick (coolant mixing with oil)
Persistent sweet white smoke billowing from exhaust tailpipe
Bubbling / frothing in coolant expansion reservoir due to combustion gas leak
Ticking or tapping valvetrain noise from loose valve tappet clearance
checks: Perform cooling system combustion gas chemical leak test (block test)
Measure valve lash / clearance using feeler gauges to manufacturer specs
Check mating deck surface flatness with precision straight edge and feeler gauge (< 0.05mm)

cylinder_head.safety_guidance: Never reuse old cylinder head stretch bolts (Torque-to-Yield / TTY). Always replace head bolts and torque them using a calibrated torque wrench and angle gauge.

clutch_plate.name: Clutch Friction Plate Assembly

specifications.Types: Multi-plate wet clutch (Motorcycles) / Single dry diaphragm clutch (Cars)
specifications.Friction Lining: Organic composite, Kevlar, or sintered bronze
specifications.Springs: Coil compression springs or diaphragm spring

price_estimate.note: Bike clutch plate set: ₹650 - ₹1,800; Car clutch kit: ₹2,800 - ₹8,500

symptoms: Clutch slippage: Engine revs jump when opening throttle, but vehicle speed does not increase
Hard, crunchy gear shifts or inability to find neutral at standstill
Burning acrid smell coming from gearbox under load or stop-and-go traffic
Vehicle shudders / vibrates violently when releasing clutch pedal from standstill
checks: Check clutch cable free play at handlebar lever (should have 10-15 mm slack)
Inspect friction plate cork thickness and check steel plates for blue heat warpage
Verify motorcycle engine oil is certified JASO MA/MA2 (standard car oils cause clutch slip)

clutch_plate.safety_guidance: In wet clutch bikes, NEVER use automotive motor oils labeled 'Energy Conserving' or containing moly friction modifiers, as they will instantly ruin clutch plates.

alternator.name: Alternator / Stator Magneto

specifications.Components: Stator field coils, rotor, diode bridge rectifier, IC voltage regulator

symptoms: Red battery symbol light stays lit on dashboard while driving
Headlights grow dim at idle and brighten when engine is revved
New battery goes dead within 2-3 days of regular driving
High-pitched whining or bearing squeal from front accessory belt
checks: Measure voltage across battery terminals while engine idles at 2,000 RPM (should be 13.8V - 14.4V)
Inspect alternator drive serpentine belt for cracks, glazing, or loose tension
Check stator coil resistance across all three yellow phase wires (0.2 - 1.0 ohm)

alternator.safety_guidance: Never disconnect the battery cables while the engine is running to test the alternator; the resulting high-voltage surge will instantly fry delicate ECU chips.

transmission.name: Transmission Gearbox

specifications.Types: Sequential Constant Mesh (Bikes), Manual / AT / CVT / DCT (Cars)
specifications.Lubrication: 75W-90 / 80W-90 Gear Oil or dedicated ATF / DCTF
specifications.Shift Mechanism: Shift drum & selector forks (Bikes) / Shift cables & synchro rings (Cars)

symptoms: Grinding noise when engaging second or third gear (worn synchronizer ring)
Gear popping out into neutral unexpectedly during acceleration
Persistent whining or roaring bearing noise that changes with road speed
Stiff, stubborn gear selector lever that resists entering gear
checks: Check transmission gear oil level and color; inspect magnetic drain plug for metal shards
Inspect gear shift linkage cables and rubber bushings for excessive slack
Ensure clutch completely disengages when lever/pedal is fully depressed

transmission.safety_guidance: Never attempt to shift into reverse while vehicle is rolling forward. Always ensure vehicle is fully stationary to avoid snapping transmission reverse idler teeth.

fuel_injector.name: Electronic Fuel Injector

price_estimate.note: Bike injector: ₹850 - ₹2,200; Car direct injector: ₹2,200 - ₹6,500 each

symptoms: Engine hesitation or stumbling on gentle throttle opening
Intermittent engine cylinder misfire with Check Engine code (P0300, P0301)
Strong smell of unburnt fuel and dark exhaust smoke if injector is leaking open
Poor fuel economy and rough idle shake
checks: Listen to injector clicking rhythm using a mechanic's stethoscope (fast rhythmic click)
Measure injector solenoid coil electrical resistance with a multimeter (11 - 16 ohms)
Inspect spray pattern for fine atomized cone mist vs dripping streaming droplets

fuel_injector.safety_guidance: Direct injection fuel rails operate under extreme pressure (up to 300+ bar). Relieve fuel system pressure properly before loosening high-pressure fuel lines.

bmw_m4_gt3.name: BMW M4 GT3 EVO

specifications.Transmission: Xtrac 6-Speed Sequential Racing Gearbox with Paddle Shift
specifications.Drivetrain: Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD) with mechanical limited-slip differential
specifications.Brakes: 6-piston front motorsport calipers with carbon cooling ducts

price_estimate.note: FIA GT3 Customer Racing Spec Car (Track only, non-street legal)

symptoms: Telemetry brake temperature spike above 750°C
Sequential gear shift lag due to low hydraulic shift pressure
Aero downforce loss caused by front splitter or rear wing endplate damage
checks: Pre-session tire pressure cold telemetry calibration (target 1.9 - 2.1 bar hot)
Inspect carbon fiber brake disc thickness and pad wear limits
Torque center-lock wheel nuts to 650 Nm specification

bmw_m4_gt3.safety_guidance: Pure track competition vehicle equipped with FIA-certified roll cage, 6-point harness, and integrated onboard fire suppression system. Not legal for public road use.

yamaha_r15.name: Yamaha YZF-R15 V4

specifications.Transmission: 6-Speed Manual with Assist & Slipper Clutch and Quick Shifter
specifications.Brakes: Dual-channel ABS with 282mm front disc and 220mm rear disc

price_estimate.note: Standard V4 to R15M Metallic Grey variant

symptoms: VVA (Variable Valve Actuation) not kicking in above 7,400 RPM
Clutch cable stiffness causing quick-shifter cut hesitation
Coolant level dropping slowly without external puddle
checks: Check engine oil level using dipstick every 1,500 km (Yamalube 10W-40 recommended)
Inspect drive chain slack (25 - 35 mm) and lubricate every 500 km
Check USD fork seals for oily dust accumulation indicating seal leakage

yamaha_r15.safety_guidance: High-revving supersport geometry requires strict observance of tire cold pressures (28 PSI front, 33 PSI rear). Always wear full face ECE/DOT helmet and riding gloves.

royal_enfield_classic_350.name: Royal Enfield Classic 350

price_estimate.note: Redditch / Halcyon to Chrome Series variants

symptoms: Handlebar wobble at 40-50 km/h due to wheel spoke tension slack or tire cupping
Tappet ticking sound from J-engine top end when fully warmed up
False neutral between 1st and 2nd gear shifts
checks: Check engine oil sight glass (Royal Enfield Semi-Synthetic 15W-50)
Inspect spoke wheel tightness by tapping spokes with small wrench (look for dull thud)
Check rear brake disc free play to prevent pad dragging on cruiser hub

royal_enfield_classic_350.safety_guidance: Substantial kerb weight of 195kg requires solid footing when parking on uneven slopes. Always park with side stand firmly locked in gear.
